hook: Catz was CEO of Oracle from 2014, first as co-CEO and then, following Mark Hurd's death in 2019, as sole CEO, before moving to the role of Executive Vice Chair of the board on September 22, 2025, when Clay Magouyrk and Mike Sicilia became co-CEOs. During her time as CEO, Oracle expanded Oracle Cloud Infrastructure and joined OpenAI and SoftBank in the Stargate AI infrastructure project announced January 21, 2025.
name: Safra Catz

quote.text: We expect Oracle Cloud Infrastructure revenue to grow 77% to $18 billion this fiscal year, and then increase to $32 billion, $73 billion, $114 billion, and $144 billion over the subsequent four years.
quote.context: Safra Catz, on Oracle Cloud Infrastructure's projected growth, Oracle fiscal first quarter 2026 earnings call, September 9, 2025

timeline.event: Becomes co-CEO of Oracle in September 2014 alongside Mark Hurd
timeline.impact: Takes joint operational leadership of Oracle under founder Larry Ellison, who becomes Executive Chairman and CTO.

timeline.event: Becomes sole CEO of Oracle following Mark Hurd's death in 2019
timeline.impact: Consolidates day to day leadership of Oracle.

timeline.event: Oracle joins the Stargate AI infrastructure project announced January 21, 2025
timeline.impact: Positions Oracle as a funder and technology partner in a large scale AI data center initiative with OpenAI and SoftBank.

timeline.event: Moves to Executive Vice Chair of Oracle's board effective September 22, 2025
timeline.impact: Ends her tenure as CEO as Clay Magouyrk and Mike Sicilia are named co-CEOs.

quick_facts: Executive Vice Chair of Oracle's board of directors since September 22, 2025
Co-CEO of Oracle from September 2014, then sole CEO following Mark Hurd's death in 2019

achievements.title: Stargate project

achievements.title: Oracle Cloud Infrastructure growth
achievements.impact: Projected OCI revenue growth from $18 billion to $144 billion over five fiscal years, driven by AI infrastructure demand, in remarks on Oracle's September 9, 2025 earnings call.
